source_notes.title: Canada.ca: Ranges in Ontario - Cedar Springs Range and Training Area
source_notes.note: The Canadian Army page states that Cedar Springs Range and Training Area was established in 1912 and is situated on approximately 134 acres southwest of Blenheim near Chatham, Ontario.

source_notes.title: Canada.ca: Highlights of New Federal Infrastructure Investments in Chatham, Ontario
source_notes.note: The 2015 Government of Canada backgrounder repeats that Cedar Springs Range and Training Area was established in 1912 and identifies it as one of three ranges in Southern Ontario.
